title: WorldWideView
content:
## Local Deployment (Docker Desktop)
Run locally to review features and concepts. Clone from GitHub link above, or use the pre-built onemindos image.
### docker-compose.yml
```yaml
version: '3.8'
services:
  worldwideview:
    image: ghcr.io/onemindos/worldwideview:latest
    # OR build from source:
    # build: .  # clone https://github.com/silvertakana/worldwideview
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: "postgresql://postgres:postgres@worldwideview-db:5432/worldwideview?schema=public"
      NEXT_PUBLIC_WWV_EDITION: "local"
      PROXY_HOST_ALLOWLIST: "*"
    volumes:
      - worldwideview-data:/app/data
    depends_on:
      - worldwideview-db
    restart: unless-stopped

  worldwideview-db:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: worldwideview
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
    volumes:
      - worldwideview-postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  worldwideview-data:
  worldwideview-postgres-data:
```
### Quick Start
```shell
# Save the above as docker-compose.yml then:
docker compose up -d

# View logs
docker compose logs -f

# Stop
docker compose down
```
<callout icon="📌">
	Removed from DOKS cluster — reference project only. Run locally when reviewing features to absorb into OneMind.
</callout>

title: WorldMonitor
content:
## Local Deployment (Docker Desktop)
Run locally to review features and concepts. Clone from GitHub link above, or use the pre-built onemindos image.
### docker-compose.yml
```yaml
version: '3.8'
services:
  worldmonitor:
    image: ghcr.io/onemindos/worldmonitor:latest
    # OR build from source:
    # build: .  # clone https://github.com/koala73/worldmonitor
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    environment:
      UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL: "http://worldmonitor-redis-rest:80"
      UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN: "your-redis-token"  # set in .env
      LOCAL_API_PORT: "46123"
      LOCAL_API_MODE: "docker"
      LOCAL_API_CLOUD_FALLBACK: "false"
      WS_RELAY_URL: "http://worldmonitor-ais-relay:3004"
      AISSTREAM_API_KEY: "your-aisstream-key"  # https://aisstream.io
    depends_on:
      - worldmonitor-redis
      - worldmonitor-redis-rest
      - worldmonitor-ais-relay
    restart: unless-stopped

  worldmonitor-ais-relay:
    image: ghcr.io/onemindos/worldmonitor-relay:latest
    ports:
      - "3004:3004"
    restart: unless-stopped

  worldmonitor-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    volumes:
      - worldmonitor-redis-data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped

  worldmonitor-redis-rest:
    image: ghcr.io/onemindos/worldmonitor-redis-rest:latest
    ports:
      - "8081:80"
    depends_on:
      - worldmonitor-redis
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  worldmonitor-redis-data:
```
### Quick Start

title: OneTAK
content:
# OneTAK — Internal Features
> OneMind fork of CloudTAK — AI-native, NATS-fabric TAK COP platform. All features below are internal to the platform.
## 🗺️ Map & Visualization
- Basemaps — switchable tile layers (satellite, street, terrain, custom XYZ/TMS sources)
- Overlays — toggleable data layers on top of basemap (CoT markers, heatmaps, geo zones, intel feeds)
- 3D Globe — Cesium integration for photorealistic 3D terrain view
- Routes — draw, import, and share navigation routes on the map
- GeoFences — define operational zones, trigger alerts on entry/exit
- Drawing Tools — shapes, lines, polygons, range rings, threat markers
- Map Search — search for coordinates, addresses, and TAK callsigns
## 📦 Data
- Data Packages — import/export .zip bundles (KML, shapefiles, imagery, missions)
- Data Sync — real-time CoT sync with TAK Server over SSL/WebSocket
- File Manager — upload/download mission files, overlays, and media
- Import — KML, KMZ, GeoJSON, Shapefile, GPX, DRW, TAK data packages
- Export — export map data, tracks, and packages to share with other TAK clients
## 💬 Communications & Collaboration
- Channels — subscribe/unsubscribe to TAK Server data channels for scoped situational awareness
- Chat — geo-referenced messaging with individual users, groups, or all connected clients
- Voice (Mumble) — integrated push-to-talk via Murmur/Mumble server (murmur.takserver.svc:64738)
- Video — MediaMTX RTSP/HLS stream viewer, attach live feeds to map markers
- Tasks — assign, track, and complete field tasks tied to map locations
## 🔌 Connections
- TAK Server — SSL connection to 152.42.155.95:8089 (tcp) / :8443 (ssl)
- NATS — live fabric connection via AI Bridge for agent-driven map ops
- Plugin System — load/unload plugins at runtime (NATS, Hermes AI, Ops, Mumble, ClickHouse, Legacy AI)
- WebSocket — real-time CoT stream browser-native connection
- External Feeds — connect custom CoT/UDP/TCP feeds and third-party data sources
## 🧠 AI & Intelligence
- Legacy AI Panel — floating Hermes chat pane, ask questions about the live map
- CopilotKit Runtime — AI co-pilot embedded in the COP interface
- TAK-ML — machine learning model inference on live video/sensor feeds
- ClickHouse Time Machine — query historical CoT tracks, replay missions
- Intel Feeds — live OSINT overlays (EMSC, GDACS, EONET, USGS, AIS, ADS-B, satellites)
## ⚙️ User & Admin
- User Management — create, enroll, and manage TAK client certificates
- Groups — assign users to operational groups for scoped data visibility
- Missions — create named missions, attach tracks, files, and chat history
- Profiles — save and restore map configurations, overlay settings, and plugin layouts
- Audit Log — track all user actions and CoT events
## 🚀 Deployment
- Live URL: https://atoc.onemindos.dev
- Namespace: cloudtak (DOKS cluster)
- Repo: github.com/onemindos/OneTAK (fork of dfpc-coe/CloudTAK)
- Image: ghcr.io/onemindos/omos:latest
- Plugins: loaded via WEB_PLUGINS build arg at container build time

title: VR-TAK
content:
> Government owned and operated — just like TAK. All hardware/software commercially available for less than \$13k/kit.
## What is VR-TAK
The VR-TAK development effort leverages virtual reality to create a virtual world capable of interacting with and manipulating data in the TAK ecosystem for mission planning and heads up augmented reality operation. The 3D content, created by FMVto3D, can be viewed using commercial virtual reality (VR) hardware, through a desktop using video game controllers/keyboard and mouse, or handheld on TAK devices.
## 📺 Viewing Modes
- Commercial VR headset (Meta Quest, etc.)
- Desktop — video game controllers, keyboard and mouse
- Handheld — on TAK-enabled Android/iOS devices
## 🎯 Use Cases
- Mission planning in immersive 3D environment
- Heads-up augmented reality operations
- 3D terrain and building visualization from FMV footage
- Interact with and manipulate live TAK ecosystem data in 3D
## ⚙️ Technical
- 3D content created by FMVto3D software
- Government owned and operated — same model as TAK
- Full kit \< \$13,000 — all COTS hardware/software
- Man-portable — fits in a Pelican case
- Operates in austere/disconnected environments
## 🔗 OneMind XR Integration
- Target: integrate VR-TAK with OneTAK + NATS fabric for live agent-driven 3D ops
- Legacy AI visible in VR — agents can manipulate map markers and mission data in 3D space
- See: onemind-xr-platform skill for full XR roadmap
## 📁 Dataset Formats Supported
### Terrain Elevation
- DTED, Quantized Mesh, Mapbox
### 3D Tiles
- gltf, b3dm, glb, geojson (polygons only)
### Point Clouds
- xyz, pts, txt, las, lax, e57
### Raw Mesh Formats
- OBJ, FBX, DAE (Collada), 3DS, BLEND, etc.
### Geo-tagged Datasets
- BuckEye, Context Capture, FG3D, Hivemapper, CORE 3D, NearMap3D, PeARL
### Other
- KML/KMZ files
- Mapbox vector tiles
## 💻 System Requirements
- OS: Windows 10 or later
- Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350 equivalent or better
- Memory: 16 GB RAM minimum
- GPU: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290 equivalent or better
## 🥽 Supported VR Headsets
<callout icon="ℹ️">
	VR headset is NOT required to run VR-TAK — desktop and handheld modes work without one.
</callout>
- HTC VIVE, VIVE Pro, and Valve Index (SteamVR)
- VIVE Cosmos (requires VIVE software)
- Oculus Rift S and S2
- Oculus Quest, Quest 2, and Quest 3
- Varjo (SteamVR)
## 🛒 Recommended Hardware Kit
<callout icon="💡">
	Total kit \~\$1,700 — well under the \$13k government kit budget.
</callout>
- Laptop: Lenovo Legion 5i — RTX 4070, 32GB DDR5, Thunderbolt 4, Windows 11 Pro (\~\$1,200)
- Headset: Meta Quest 3 128GB — VR + full color AR passthrough + standalone mode (\~\$499)
- Connect Quest 3 to Legion via USB-C (wired) or Air Link WiFi (wireless)
- Quest 3 also supports AR mixed reality — real world with TAK data overlaid
